title: Add a Delivery Address
intro:
Hi team,
Kindly help us clarify the following points on FD-12 (Add a Delivery Address):

sections.heading: Description
sections.html:
1Description

As a customer, I want to add a delivery address at checkout so that my order is delivered to the right place.

2Context

Customers reach this screen from the cart. The address they save is used for this order and kept in their account for next time.

3Scope

In scope

  • Adding a new delivery address.
  • Choosing a label (Home, Work, Other).
  • Pinning the location on a map.
  • Editing and deleting saved addresses.

Out of scope

  • Payment.
  • Delivery fee calculation.
  • Order tracking.

4Fields

FieldTypeReq.Validation / business rule
LabelDropdownYesHome, Work or Other
Street addressTextYesMax 120 characters
Building / apartmentTextNoMax 30 characters
CityDropdownYesCities we deliver to
AreaDropdownYesSelect from the areas of the chosen city
Phone numberNumbersYesMust be a valid phone number
Delivery notesTextNoMax 200 characters
Map pinMapYesMust be inside a delivery zone

5Business rules

  • Customers can save up to 5 addresses.
  • The first saved address becomes the default address.
  • The default address is preselected at checkout.

6Designs

See the address form mock-up below.

sections.heading: Acceptance criteria
sections.html:
S1Open the address form

Giventhe customer is at checkout Whenthey select Add new address Thenthe address form is displayed.

S2Save a valid address

Givenall required fields are valid Whenthe customer selects Save Thenthe address is saved to their account Andit is selected for the current order.

S3Required fields

Givena required field is empty Whenthe customer selects Save Thenthe field is highlighted Andthe address is not saved.

S4Choose a city and area

Giventhe customer selects a city Whenthey open the Area list Thenonly the areas of that city are shown.

S5Pin the location

Giventhe address form is open Whenthe customer moves the map pin Thenthe pin location is saved with the address.

S6Delivery notes

Giventhe customer adds delivery notes Thendelivery notes shall support up to 250 characters.

S7Saved addresses list

Giventhe customer has saved addresses Whenthey open Delivery address Thenthey see all saved addresses Andthey can keep up to 10 saved addresses.

S8Default address

Giventhe customer has a default address Whenthey start checkout Thenthe default address is preselected.

sections.heading: Discussion
sections.html:
QA

@Product Owner Please share the exact error messages for:

  • Street address is empty.
  • Phone number is invalid.

findings.title: How many addresses can be saved: 5 or 10?
findings.why: The business rules allow 5 saved addresses, but Scenario 7 says the customer can keep up to 10.
findings.q: What is the maximum number of saved addresses: 5 (business rules) or 10 (Scenario 7)? What happens when the customer reaches it?

anchors.text: Customers can save up to 5 addresses.
anchors.label: Business rules

anchors.text: they can keep up to 10 saved addresses.
anchors.label: Scenario 7

findings.title: Delivery notes: 200 or 250 characters?
findings.why: The field table limits delivery notes to 200 characters; Scenario 6 says 250.
findings.q: What is the maximum length of delivery notes: 200 (field table) or 250 (Scenario 6)?

anchors.text: delivery notes shall support up to 250 characters.
anchors.label: Scenario 6

findings.title: "Valid phone number" is not defined
findings.why: The accepted format is not stated (local only, international with country code, mobile only?).
findings.q: Which phone formats are valid: local mobile numbers only, or international numbers with a country code too?

anchors.text: Must be a valid phone number

findings.title: What if the pin is outside a delivery zone?
findings.why: The map pin must be inside a delivery zone, but no scenario says what the customer sees or can do when it isn't.
findings.q: What happens when the customer drops the pin outside a delivery zone: is Save blocked, and what message do they see?

anchors.text: Must be inside a delivery zone
the pin location is saved with the address.

findings.title: Default address after delete or edit
findings.why: The first address becomes the default, but the story doesn't say how to change the default or what happens when it is deleted.
findings.q: Can the customer change the default address, and which address becomes the default when the current one is deleted?

anchors.text: The first saved address becomes the default address.

findings.title: Editing and deleting have no scenario
findings.why: Editing and deleting saved addresses are in scope, but there are no acceptance criteria for them.
findings.q: How does the customer edit or delete a saved address, and is a confirmation needed before deleting?

findings.title: Guest checkout
findings.why: The address is saved to the customer's account, but it isn't clear whether guests (not signed in) can add an address.
findings.q: Can guests without an account add a delivery address? If yes, where is it stored?

anchors.text: the address is saved to their account

findings.title: Where does the Area list come from?
findings.why: Areas depend on the chosen city, but the source and owner of the list are not defined.
findings.q: Who maintains the list of areas per city, and what happens if a city has no areas yet?

anchors.text: Select from the areas of the chosen city
